description: This file defines the 'Events' class under the 'Step\Acceptance' namespace, which includes methods for acceptance testing related to event creation in the application. It interacts with various page objects to simulate user actions in creating an event.

classes.name: Events
classes.description: Acceptance testing class for automating the creation of events within the SuiteCRM application.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Automates the process of creating a new event by filling out the form with specified name and location, and setting date and time fields.
